about: Karnataka 1st and 2nd PUC prescribed practicals (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) mapped to KINETIX virtual labs (packages/kinetix_labs) and to lesson chapters (apps/board/assets/lessons/puc). The practical list is compiled from the NCERT-aligned PU syllabus and must be checked against the current DPUE list: every entry needs_verification. coverage: existing = a lab that was already in kinetix_labs, new = a lab added for this list, missing = no lab yet.
